title: Govern the epistemedia.org canonical identifier namespace
objective: Migrate active canonical schema, policy, discovery, and record identifier namespaces from the unowned epistemedia.com domain to epistemedia.org while preserving replay, historical identity, and explicit compatibility semantics.
acceptance: new canonical identifiers use epistemedia.org without repurposing any previously accepted stable ID
episte.media is not used as a schema, policy, record, or canonical discovery namespace
accepted historical records retain their original bytes and identifiers
an explicit migration map distinguishes legacy identifiers from current identifiers
validators and replay fixtures define whether and how legacy identifiers remain accepted
all schema const values, generated discovery records, and local proposal identifiers follow the approved compatibility rule
catalog, frontier, and content-digest changes are measured and recorded
independent evaluation is loaded from the accepted base and recorded before promotion

evidence.context: The owner controls epistemedia.org and selected it as the canonical namespace; episte.media is a sharing redirect only.

limitations: This task does not authorize rewriting merged task contracts, run receipts, governance events, or release records.
Domain control proves namespace custody, not the truth of represented knowledge.
